note: USACE campground on the west shore of New Hogan Lake near Valley Springs: two loops on open oak-grassland either side of a cove. Paved driveways may not be level, so bring levelling blocks. The dump station runs only in the peak season. Gates open 8 a.m. to 10 p.m. --Claude
summary: Acorn (New Hogan, USACE): $20 every season on rec.gov; 126 sites (122 take a 23-ft rig, RV max 40 ft), no hookups, showers; East loop year-round, West loop closed mid-Nov to end of March; stored lakeview is at least earned, and a lakefront upgrade is offered on named sites (015/017, 100-102/105) measured to the spring high-water line.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (upgrade candidate lakeview -> lakefront, reviewer decides; stored lakeview kept meanwhile): measured at the rec.gov site points against the spring high-water line (CDEC NHG yearly highs 686-694 ft, i.e. about 209.1-211.5 m NGVD29, ~0.75 m more in the NAVD88 the DEM uses). East loop sites 100 (38.17301,-120.79243, 215.5 m), 101 (38.17343,-120.79248, 214.7 m), 102 (38.17372,-120.79252, 214.9 m) and 105 (38.17403,-120.79259, 214.3 m) sit on the outer side of the loop road with open, unused dry grass to the shore: ~25-30 m to the water in the Esri frame (taken at a high level), the DEM reaching 211.4 m ~19 m east of site 100, i.e. pads ~3-4 m above the high-water edge over a ~15-20% slope. West loop sites 015 (38.17445,-120.79803, 213.9 m) and 017 face an open bare sand/dirt apron ~40 m to the imaged water and ~15-20 m to the 211.5 m contour, ~2-2.5 m above it over ~12%. Boats are pulled up on that apron in the imagery. All are reservable single sites sold by the night and fit a 23-ft rig; the West loop is closed mid-November to March. Against this: the lake runs well below the high-water line from summer on (665.7 ft on 2026-11-25, 60 m+ of bare drawdown flat), and the East pads are 3-4 m up. Old evidence ('nearest pads set back beyond ~50m ... across the drawdown bench') was read at low pool. Proposed evidence if raised: 'rec.gov site points on Esri + 3DEP 2026-11-26: sites 015/017 (West) ~15-20 m and 2-2.5 m above the spring high-water line (CDEC highs 686-694 ft) over an open unused sand apron; 100-102/105 (East) ~20-30 m and 3-4 m above over open grass, no road between; drawdown leaves 60 m+ of flat by autumn.'

FIT: 122 of 126 sites take an RV or trailer (RV max_length 40, driveways 27-99 ft). The site attribute 'Max Vehicle Length 20' is the same on 123 sites beside RV 40 / driveway 64 and reads as a placeholder (second-vehicle) value - not a limit.
